archetypes.name: dyn-process-safety
archetypes.rationale: Process identity and kill paths are safety-critical across concurrent clones.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed process-signaling paths for stale or recycled pid/pgid hazards. Focus on whether active-leg and Step 3 cleanup validate ownership, start time, pgid, and command identity before any persisted/retained target is signaled. Check that refusal and malformed-record paths fail closed without deleting foreign live state. Inspect logging to ensure kill attribution happens before signals without leaking sensitive command content. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
